about.body: The M47D20 is a BMW-sourced 2.0-litre turbocharged diesel engine, used in Land Rover applications between 2000 and 2006. It's an inline-four common-rail diesel, also found in BMW 3 Series and 5 Series of the same era. In Land Rover form, it appears in the Defender Td4 and Freelander 1 TD4, where it replaced earlier diesel options and offered improved refinement and efficiency.

byModel.body: In the Defender (L316), the M47D20 was fitted as the Td4 between 2002 and 2006. In the Freelander 1 (L314), it was fitted as the TD4 between 2000 and 2006 — one of the engine options during that model's production run.

compatibility.body: The M47D20 is a BMW engine, not a JLR-designed engine. While the base engine is shared with BMW applications, the specific ancillaries and mounting differ by Land Rover application. Registration/VIN matching is required — M47D20 variants differ by power output (82 kW / 112 hp) and the specific vehicle installation.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
